A few things to mention:

A cage with holes in it will only filter out the frequencies larger than the holes. Look up the wavelength size of 5g and then you may decide to use window screen mesh or aluminum foil instead. This is an added cost, only you can decide if it's worth it.

A Faraday cage only works if it's connected to ground. And only if all parts of it are connected to each other. You'll want to get two or three earth grounds (the big metal spikes that you drive 5 feet into the ground) and connect them to points all around your cage. Then you'll want to make sure all your sheets are well connected to each other - sand the wires until they're bare metal, get some electrical solder and get them all hooked up nice and solid. Often these wire meshes are built to be sturdy, but not build to be electrically connected together. Just because you've hooked up one wire does not guarantee all the wires it touches are connected.

Because it's cheap, effective and guaranteed to be electrically connected across the sheet, I would strongly recommend you use a layer of heavy duty aluminum foil somewhere in there. Staple it to the studs or glue it to the plaster boards.
